insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Rumble is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Rumble in 15/30 games (50%): 3 picks (1-2) and 12 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Ezreal? They go Kai'Sa
insights.text: Ezreal is a G1 favorite (6/19 G1s, played by Paduck). In the 9 later games where it was burned or banned, Paduck went to Kai'Sa (2/9) and Varus (2/9).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Varus against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Varus against them in 14/30 games (47%).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Orianna
insights.text: Orianna is their first ban in 9/30 games (30%). Expect it gone before your first pick.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 3 G3+ games, 7/15 picks (47%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 47 champs in G1s, 14 in G3+.
